carousel.title: Haitian Third-Grader Taken Into Federal Custody After San Diego ICE Check-In
carousel.excerpt: San Diego Unified says an 8-year-old Fay Elementary student was separated from the uncle caring for him at a scheduled appointment. DHS says the man could not establish legal guardianship, so the boy was classed as an unaccompanied minor and sent to the Office of Refugee Resettlement.
carousel.nri_angle: The case shows how the end of Haiti TPS on July 27, 2026 reaches into US classrooms: a child who complied with an ICE summons was reclassified as an unaccompanied minor because his caregiver could not document legal guardianship.

carousel.title: BJP Wins 77 Tripura Civic Seats Unopposed as Opposition Alleges Intimidation
carousel.excerpt: The State Election Commission declared 77 BJP candidates elected unopposed after the withdrawal of nominations closed, leaving 268 of the state's 345 urban local body seats to be contested on November 27.
carousel.nri_angle: Tripura's civic outcome shapes local governance in a state many diaspora families hail from, and the unopposed wins will frame the fairness debate around the November 27 vote.

carousel.title: ISRO Test-Fires GSLV Cryogenic Engine for 200 Seconds Ahead of NVS-04 Launch
carousel.excerpt: The CE-7.5 engine cleared its flight acceptance hot test at the ISRO Propulsion Complex in Mahendragiri on November 5, and will now be fitted into the cryogenic stage of the GSLV-F19 mission that will carry the NVS-04 navigation satellite.
carousel.nri_angle: A completed NavIC constellation strengthens the navigation services used across transport, maritime and disaster response in India, reducing dependence on foreign systems such as GPS.
